name: tpl-existence-1-goal~p2
task: Grab the key first, then make your way to the goal.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the task 'Grab the key first, then make your way to the goal' is a first-then order. Existence(at_goal) hard captures 'make your way to the goal', and Precedence(has_key, at_goal) hard captures 'grab the key first' (at_goal may not occur before has_key). The hard Existence(at_goal) together with hard Precedence(has_key, at_goal) already forces has_key, so no Existence(has_key) is needed and none is present. No door clause is added, matching the task's own wording (the environment handles the door). Both clauses are hard, matching the categorical 'first ... then' with no preference cue. The machine accepts exactly the runs where the goal is reached and not before the key is held, and still accepts a run where the key is dropped after opening the door, which is the correct reading of 'grab the key first, then make your way to the goal' rather than 'carry the key to the goal'.

texts: The agent must reach the goal.
The agent must not reach the goal before having the key.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u3
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&has_key) -> u1
(u0, at_goal&!has_key) -> u2
(u0, at_goal&has_key) -> u3
(u1, at_goal) -> u3
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&has_key, u1) -> 1
(u0, at_goal&!has_key, u2) -> -10
(u0, at_goal&has_key, u3) -> 12
(u1, at_goal, u3) -> 11
